factions.name: Halloran-Vey Combine
factions.description: The company that owns the Corva operation, its ships, its air, and the debts of everyone who breathes it.

factions.name: The Bonded of the Patience
factions.description: The three hundred indentured crew of the skimmer Patience: riggers, runners, tether hands, medics, trusties.

factions.name: The Shareholders
factions.description: The shared families of the city of Patience, who hold the Shares, the vote and the air rights by descent from the Three Hundred.

factions.name: The Unshared
factions.description: Everyone else in Patience: a hundred and seventy thousand people who pay the air-tithe and have no vote.

factions.name: The Lampers
factions.description: A poor people's heresy of the lower warrens: the Lamp comes round, the debt comes due.

factions.name: The Concord of Vey
factions.description: A corporate-feudal power that bought up the dead Combine's claims, and has come to collect Corva.

factions.name: Crew of the Dray
factions.description: A salvage tug out of Cinderhaven, and the people who keep it in the black.

factions.name: Szabo's House
factions.description: Mother Szabo's counting-house on Cinderhaven: debts bought, bonds held, ships repossessed.

factions.name: The Tarn Directorate
factions.description: The government of the Tarn Reach, such as it is: forty years of emergency powers and a navy that cannot pay its crews.

factions.name: The Roundsmen
factions.description: A faith of the dipper diaspora: what goes out comes back; nothing is lost, only on its way.
